title: Australian man records astronaut private channel

tellings.quote: Um who the hell did we meet? some guy from Australia that um had been recording and when they switched to a different channel, he was able to switch

plain: A man in Australia is said to have recorded astronauts' radio traffic, and when the astronauts switched to a different, private channel, he was able to switch with them. Charlie Foltz, a guest on an episode about alien abduction, tells Michels about meeting this man, though he can't quite recall who he was ('who the hell did we meet?'). The point is that the man may have caught talk that was never meant for the public.
